jobs.occupation: Expert SAP S/4 HANA Cloud Engagement Management (f/m/d) (Büroassistent/in)
jobs.description: Join our Community of SolversWe are looking for a Expert SAP S/4 HANA Cloud Engagement Management (f/m/d) to join our Business Services division starting from March 2026.Your responsibilitiesResponsibility – You will be part of the Products & Technology team and will assume technical responsibility for the engagement management processes in the S/4HANA Public Cloud solution, ensuring a solution that is close to standard functions and industry requirements.Guidelines – You will define guidelines, standards, and the solution architecture for EM to ensure that they are in line with our future system landscape. In addition, you will evaluate S/4 HANA Public Cloud innovations and support continuous improvement.Integration – You will ensure the provision and maintenance of SAP S/4 HANA-based processes and solutions within the EM area, as well as their end-to-end integration. In addition, you will support Level 3 support and root cause analysis within S/4HANA Cloud, x-BOS solutions, and technical integration.Innovations – You evaluate and implement cloud innovations that can bring improvements through technologies such as RPA and ML.Your profile- You have completed your studies in (business) information technology, economics, or a comparable degree program.- You have several years of experience in SAP engagement management, e.g., in sales/opportunity/project management. Ideally, you have initial experience with S/4HANA Public Cloud and implementation in a multi-tenant/public cloud environment.- In addition, you ideally have knowledge of SSCUI configuration for engagement management, including sales, material master, pricing, CPM, and EPPM.- You are fluent in English and German both spoken and written.- Your analytical, independent, and structured approach to work supports you defining guidelines. Furthermore, your communication enables effective collaboration with various teams.Your benefitsFlexibility – In coordination with your team, you can expect a mix of working in the office and home office. There are no core working hours – within the scope of operational requirements and legal regulations, you can organize your working hours flexibly. In addition, you have the opportunity to work temporarily in over 40 countries.Career Development – We are passionate about your personal and professional development, therefore we offer your regular training with our internal Academy, international experiences by doing a secondment and continuous mentoring on the job. Also, we support you on finding suitable external trainings and further education programmes. Lifestyle – You can accumulate overtime on your annual working time account (JAZ) and compensate for it with time off after busy periods. Any remaining overtime is paid out once a year. You also have 30 days of vacation per calendar year.Health and Wellbeing – Your health is important to us: in addition to our own company health insurance scheme, we also offer preventive medical check-ups and divers sport offerings. Take part in our free company sports programme or benefit from reduced rates at various gyms or an Urban Sports Club membership.And there is even more – It is our purpose to create a positive working environment: An environment where flexible and creative working is possible, where work is recognized and performance is rewarded and of which we are all very proud. You can find more detailed information on all of our benefits on our career website.At PwC Germany, it is our purpose to solve our clients' key challenges, create sustainable outcomes and build trust in business and society. As part of our internal IT team (Products & Technology), you are the driver behind our promise: human-led and tech-powered. We are experts for our technology solutions and make the use of technology easier and more efficient. As a team, we develop innovative solutions for the entire product life cycle and manage the use of technology in the organization. Drive the technological development of PwC Germany in our diverse teams!ContactIf you have any questions about this position or your application, please reach out to Patricia Weiss at +49 69 9585-2222.

jobs.occupation: Service Product Manager (Berater/in - Erneuerbare Energien)
jobs.description: ENERCON GmbHShape the Future of Wind Energy ServicesAt ENERCON, we are committed to driving the energy transition through innovative wind energy solutions and industry-leading service offerings. To strengthen our Service Product Management team, we are looking for a Service Product Manager (m/f/d) who will take ownership of our service portfolio and help create sustainable value for our customers worldwide.Your Responsibilities:- Own the product strategy, roadmap, and lifecycle performance of a dedicated service product line within our global service value offerings portfolio.- Identify and translate customer needs, market trends, competitive developments, and fleet insights into innovative product requirements and growth opportunities.- Lead the end-to-end development and commercialization of service products, including value proposition development, business case creation, pricing, profitability management, product documentation, marketing materials, and go-to-market activities.- Ensure product readiness throughout the entire lifecycle, from market launch to ongoing operational excellence.- Drive cross-functional collaboration and alignment across Engineering, Sales, Service, After Sales, Legal, and other key stakeholders.- Monitor business performance, customer feedback, and market developments to continuously enhance product competitiveness and customer value.- Contribute to the growth and profitability of ENERCON's global service business through data-driven product decisions and portfolio optimization.Your Qualifications:- University degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Economics, or a related discipline; an MBA is considered an advantage.- Several years of professional experience in Product Management, Service Management, or Business Development within the renewable energy sector, ideally in the wind industry.- Strong understanding of wind turbine technology, wind farm operations, customer value drivers, and service business models.- Proven commercial and analytical skills, particularly in portfolio management, business case development, pricing, and product commercialization.- Demonstrated ability to lead stakeholders and successfully manage cross-functional initiatives in international environments.- Structured, proactive, and results-driven working style with excellent communication and relationship-building abilities.- Fluent English language skills; German language skills are considered a plus.What We Offer:- A meaningful role contributing to the global energy transition.- The opportunity to shape innovative service products with a direct impact on customer success and business growth.- An international and collaborative working environment with diverse stakeholders.- Professional development opportunities and long-term career perspectives.- Flexible working models and attractive employment conditions.Join ENERCON and help us create innovative service solutions that maximize the performance and value of wind energy assets worldwide.

jobs.occupation: Postdoctoral researcher for X-ray microscopy at atomic resolution (Physiker/in)
jobs.description: For our location in Hamburg we are seeking:Postdoctoral researcher for X-ray microscopy at atomic resolutionRemuneration Group 13 | Limited: 2 years | Starting date: earliest possible | ID: FSPO009/2026 | Deadline: 09.12.2026 | Full-time/Part-timeDESY, with more than 2900 employees at its two locations in Hamburg and Zeuthen, is one of the world's leading research centres. Its research focuses on decoding the structure and function of matter, from the smallest particles of the universe to the building blocks of life. In this way, DESY contributes to solving the major questions and urgent challenges facing science, society and industry. With its ultramodern research infrastructure, its interdisciplinary research platforms and its international networks, DESY offers a highly attractive working environment in the fields of science, technology and administration as well as for the education of highly qualified young scientists.The Advanced Multilayer X-ray Optics group at CFEL is one of the leading research groups developing novel X-ray lenses, also known as multilayer Laue Lenses (MLLs). We plan to further improve and extend MLLs as part of a large project to image, understand and ultimately control electron dynamics in molecular systems. To do this, we are combining concepts from X-ray microscopy, crystallography, and ultrafast X-ray science. Here is an opportunity for a highly motivated postdoctoral researcher to be part of our team and this exciting project.About your role:- Prepare and conduct scientific experiments at various X-ray facilities (synchrotrons and XFELs)- Develop and apply techniques to characterize and improve X-ray lenses (MLLs) and gratings- Extend and improve X-ray imaging modalities towards atomic resolution- Explore feasibility of MLLs for various experiments and for their increased use at lab, synchrotron and XFEL sources- Communicate findings via publications and presentationsAbout you:- PhD in physics, applied physics or a related field- Sound knowledge of Fourier optics, X-ray physics, and metrology- Experience in experimental methods or development of instrumentation- Experience with synchrotron and XFEL experiments is an advantage- Good programming skills, especially in Python- Proficient in English and in writing scientific articles- Excellent interpersonal and communication skills- High self-motivation and ability to work in an interdisciplinary teamGood reasons to join:Look forward to a unique working environment on our international research campus. Respectful cooperation and the well-being of our DESY employees are particularly important to us. Gender equality is an important aspect for us. To support work-life balance, we offer flexible working hours and variable part-time. You will benefit from our family-friendly and collegial atmosphere, our established health management and occupational pension provision. As a public funded employer, we offer you a secure workplace and facilitate your individual career with our comprehensive training and development opportunities. Remuneration is according to the regulations of the TV-AVH. DESY offers its employees a financial supplement for a German job ticket (Deutschland-Ticket) at both locations.For further information, please contact Dr. Saša Bajt at +49 8998‑2082 (https://tel:+4989982082) (sasa.bajt@desy.de (https://mailto:sasa.bajt@desy.de) ).Please submit your complete application documents (letter of motivation and research interests, CV, list of publications, relevant certificates and three letters of references). Please use our online tool for the submission of the letters of reference: Additional application documents (https://cockpit.as-mediendesign.de/jump1/135320/2/892)We look forward to receiving your application via our application portal:Apply now! (https://cockpit.as-mediendesign.de/jump1/135320)DESY promotes equal opportunities, diversity and inclusion (https://cockpit.as-mediendesign.de/jump1/135320/2/2544) . We therefore welcome applications from people of all dimensions of diversity. The professional development of women (https://cockpit.as-mediendesign.de/jump1/135320/2/2820) is very important to us and therefore we strongly encourage women to apply for the vacant position. Applications from severely disabled persons and those with equivalent status will be given preference if they are equally qualified (sbv.desy.de (https://cockpit.as-mediendesign.de/jump1/135320/2/699) ).You can find further information here:https://www.desy.de/career/apprenticeship/ (https://cockpit.as-mediendesign.de/jump1/135320/2/3781)Deutsches Elektronen-Synchrotron DESYHuman Resources Department | Notkestraße 85 | 22607 HamburgPhone: +49 40 8998‑3392 (https://tel:+494089983392)

jobs.occupation: Marketing Manager Global Campaigns (Fachwirt/in - Marketing/Bachelor Professional in Marketing)
jobs.description: ENERCON GmbHIn your role, you will shape the global campaign framework of ENERCON's solutions portfolio - from wind turbines and service offerings to our extended range of solutions, such as industrial power solutions. Together with your colleagues in the Global Communications and Marketing team, you will develop the overall campaign direction in close collaboration with Product and Solutions Management and Sales.We are looking for a new colleague to join us as soon as possible.This position is aligned within the Core Job PR & Marketing Manager III and salary group 6.Marketing Manager Global Campaigns (m/f/d)Your responsibilities:- You'll bring ENERCON's solutions portfolio to market through integrated B2B marketing campaigns, taking each campaign from the first strategic idea through planning and hands-on delivery to reviewing results and refining the approach.- Every campaign starts with a clear sense of who we want to reach and what we want to say. You'll turn target audiences, positioning and key messages into scalable global campaign frameworks, using a thoughtful customer journey and a clear content and channel architecture to give every activity its place.- From there, you'll bring the campaign to life across channels, steering the development and delivery of the right assets - from content and digital activities to event, presentation and sales enablement materials.- Making it happen is a shared effort. Working closely with Product and Solutions Management, Sales, and other internal and external partners, you'll keep campaign projects moving across functions, markets and regions. You'll also support your colleagues in Corporate Communications and Global Marketing on overarching corporate campaigns when needed.- The journey doesn't end with the first response. Your campaigns will attract qualified leads and nurture their interest, with lead nurturing processes and a handover to Sales that you'll shape and improve in close collaboration with the sales team.- A global idea needs to connect locally. You'll equip regional Marketing and Communications teams to adapt campaigns to their markets, while giving Sales relevant messages, materials and ideas to engage customers.- What works well should make the next campaign stronger. By turning proven approaches into campaign standards, reusable building blocks and clear processes, you'll help our campaigns scale globally, make better use of automation and run more efficiently.Your profile:- B2B marketing and campaign management are familiar territory: you bring several years of experience, ideally gained in an international industrial, technology or energy business.- Behind a complex solution or technology, you can find the story that matters to customers. You combine a sound understanding of products and solutions with a feel for customer needs, turning that knowledge into clear messages and campaign approaches that support Sales.- For you, a campaign is more than a collection of activities. It's about connecting audiences, messaging, content, channels and timing, right through to sales enablement - always with customer needs, sales relevance and measurable results in mind.- You communicate clearly and reliably, write with precision and a strong sense of your audience, and work confidently across functions, regions and organisational levels.- Good ideas make you want to get started. You enjoy turning them into action, working independently with structure, pragmatism and a hands-on mindset.- Marketing automation is a practical part of your craft. From campaign set-up and lead nurturing to email marketing and performance reporting, you know how the pieces fit together.- Paid social is familiar ground, too. You have experience with LinkedIn, Facebook and Instagram and work confidently with audiences, ad formats, budgets and performance metrics.- Curiosity keeps you looking for better ways to work. You see the potential in new tools for automation, personalisation, content production and campaign management, and bring your own ideas to the conversation.- Your excellent written and spoken German and English help you communicate convincingly in an international environment.

jobs.occupation: Life Scientist (m/w/d) (Chemiker/in)
jobs.description: At the Max Planck Institute for Multidisciplinary Sciences, we bridge the gap between basic research and translational, preclinical approaches. Here, researchers from the fields of biology, chemistry, physics, and medicine collaborate across disciplines, supported by high-performance service facilities and a modern research infrastructure. As the largest institute of the Max Planck Society, with around 1,000 employees from more than 66 nations, we offer an inspiring, international working environment with exceptional scientific breadth.The research group Ubiquitin Signaling Specificity (Dr. Sonja Lorenz) invites applications for the position asPostdoc (f/m/d)- Cryo-EM Analyses of Ubiquitin Ligase Complexes - Our laboratory aims to understand how the posttranslational modifier ubiquitin coordinates eukaryotic physiology. A major key lies in the action of ubiquitin ligases that recruit specific substrates for ubiquitination and determine which ubiquitin signals they are decorated with. The immense potential of ubiquitin ligases for therapeutic applications has been illustrated by the clinical efficacy of immunomodulatory drugs in the treatment of hematological malignancies and recent advances with PROTACs and molecular glues. However, efficient targeting of ubiquitin ligases in the clinic is still limited by our insufficient understanding of their structural mechanisms, regulation, and integration into cellular pathways.We offer a Postdoc position focusing on revealing structural mechanisms of specificity, regulation, and substrate recognition by ubiquitin ligases. Available projects center on cryo-EM as a principle structural tool, but may also integrate other structural techniques, including X-ray crystallography, as well as biophysical and biochemical analyses of enzymatic activities and protein interactions. For a representative example of our integrated research approach, please seeNat Struct Mol Biol. 2024 Feb;31(2):364-377. doi: 10.1038/s41594-023-01203-4Candidates should hold/soon expect a PhD or equivalent degree in a relevant area of the life sciences. A strong published track record in single-particle cryo-EM (or cryo-ET) and in protein biochemistry is essential. The successful candidate should be curiosity-driven, creative, and passionate about science. A high degree of self-motivation and independence is important, as well as the ability to communicate well within an international, multidisciplinary team. The position is initially limited to two years, with the possibility of extension. Remuneration is based on the TVöD Bund (German federal civil service pay scale), depending on qualifications and professional experience. In addition, public sector social benefits apply.We are committed to being a cosmopolitan institute that offers a diverse and inclusive working environment with equal opportunities. We also aim to increase the number of employees with disabilities. We welcome applications from all backgrounds.A stimulating and collaborative international research environmentProfessional development opportunities, skills training, and the Max Planck Society’s online training academySupport for balancing work and family life, including on-campus childcare placesCorporate health management, fitness and sports programsspacious on-site cafeteria offering warm meals and a salad barSustainability initiatives and a nature-oriented campus environment, including the BioDiversum biotope projectAbout usBased at one of Germany’s premier research campuses, our research group has access to leading-edge infrastructure in all areas of cell and structural biology, including cryo-EM and superresolution imaging. We are an ambitious international team, supported by the Max Planck Society, the German Research Foundation, among other sources. Our working language is English; knowledge of German is not required.
